newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks end week lower.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks end week lower.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly lower on Friday in weak trade, with Podravka coming into the spotlight.
* Of 13 issues two rose, nine fell and two were flat.
* Volume fell to 3,759 from 4,562 units, turnover totalling 1.5 million kuna.
* Of two gainers Podvarka added six kuna or 2.4 percent to 256 kuna on volume of 2,617 shares.
* Biggest decliner Istraturist lost 13 kuna or 7.3 percent to 165.00 with 203 shares sold.
* Podravka, selling 2,617 shares, was the most active issue.
